title: Signals Are Present, Predictions Fail: Probing Diagram Representations in Large Vision-Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2603.02865v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) demonstrate strong performance on diagram understanding benchmarks, yet they still struggle to understand relationships between elements, particularly those represented by directed edges between nodes. To investigate the causes of this limitation, we probe the internal representations of LVLMs using a synthetic diagram dataset based on directed graphs. Our linear probing experiments reveal that signals about nodes and edges are linearly decodable from the hidden states of LVLMs, even for aspects that LVLMs struggle with in VQA, such as edge direction and connectivity between nodes. These results reveal a gap between internal signals and model outputs. We further perform causal interventions on the model's hidden states, showing that, for some aspects, the signals identified through probing causally contribute to the model's final predictions. translated_title: 信号存在，预测却失败：探测大型视觉语言模型中的图表表示
translated_abstract: 大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）在图表理解基准测试中表现出强大的性能，但它们仍然难以理解元素之间的关系，尤其是由节点之间有向边所表示的关系。为了探究这一局限性的原因，我们使用基于有向图的合成图表数据集对LVLMs的内部表示进行探测。我们的线性探测实验表明，关于节点和边的信号可以从LVLMs的隐藏状态中线性解码出来，即使是LVLMs在视觉问答（VQA）中表现不佳的方面，例如边的方向和节点之间的连通性，也不例外。这些结果揭示了内部信号与模型输出之间的差距。我们进一步对模型的隐藏状态进行因果干预，结果表明，对于某些方面，通过探测所识别出的信号确实对模型的最终预测产生因果贡献。这些发现在流程图上也成立，而不仅限于合成……（摘要此处被截断）
tldr: 本研究通过对大型视觉语言模型进行线性探测与因果干预，发现其内部隐藏状态中线性可解码地存在着节点与边的信号（包括模型在视觉问答中失败的边方向和连通性等），且部分信号对最终预测有因果贡献，揭示了内部信号与模型输出之间的差距。
